title: C Major Scale, One Octave, Hands Separately
description: The C major scale up and down one octave with the standard fingering, right hand then left hand, first in quarter notes and then in eighths.

arrangements.label: Intermediate
arrangements.notes: Each hand plays alone: RH 1-2-3-1-2-3-4-5 ascending (reverse descending), LH 5-4-3-2-1-3-2-1; bars 1-8 in quarters, bars 9-12 the same in eighths.
teachingPoints: RH: the thumb crosses UNDER after finger 3 (E to F going up); descending, finger 3 crosses OVER the thumb (F to E).
LH: fingers 5-4-3-2 then thumb on G; finger 3 crosses OVER the thumb to A. Descending, after 3 on A the thumb tucks UNDER to G, then 2-3-4-5.
Prepare the crossing finger early: start moving it toward its key while the previous note is still sounding.
Bars 9-12 double the speed; keep the eighths even - the crossings are where scales lurch, so slow down until they disappear.
